les: Siektes wat van mens tot mens oorgaan
kaps_punt: Oordraagbare siektes soos pampoentjies, tuberkulose, verkoue, waterpokkies, atleetvoet, ensovoorts. Oorsake van oordraagbare siektes; Tekens en simptome van oordraagbare siektes; Waar om inligting te vind: Voorkomingstrategieë; en Beskikbare behandeling.

items.bewering: teken: "Iets wat 'n siekte aan 'n mens verander en wat ander kan sien of meet, soos 'n uitslag of koors."
items.bron: This is the changed entry, checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026. Wikipedia, 'Signs and symptoms', and Cleveland Clinic, 'Signs and Symptoms: What's the Difference?': a sign is objective, something others can observe or measure. Fever measured with a thermometer is given as a sign, and a rash that someone else sees is a sign. Read alone, the entry is accurate. Other things that fit it are also true signs, such as a swollen jaw or weight loss. The entry does not say signs are ONLY what can be seen or measured, so leaving out 'hear' makes nothing false. Both examples are sometimes also symptoms (a fever that is felt, a rash the patient notices), but the entry does not deny that. The entry now uses the same words as the study text ('sien of meet'), so the two are consistent.

items.bewering: simptoom: "Iets wat 'n mens self voel omdat hy siek is, soos pyn, moegheid of 'n seer keel."
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Signs and symptoms'; Cleveland Clinic, 'Signs and Symptoms'; GoodRx, 'Signs vs Symptoms': a symptom is subjective, felt or experienced only by the person who is ill. All three examples are felt. Read alone, the entry is accurate. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Pyn en moegheid is simptome omdat die siek mens dit self voel. Koors en 'n uitslag is tekens omdat ander dit kan sien of meet.
items.bron: Cleveland Clinic, 'Signs and Symptoms', and Wikipedia, 'Signs and symptoms': pain and tiredness are symptoms. A measured fever and a rash that others see are signs. Each sentence says what something IS, not what it is not, so both are true. A clinic poster may still list fever as a 'symptom' (health.gov.za, TB screening information). That is not a contradiction, because fever is genuinely both. Both sentences match the two glossary entries word for word. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Ander kinders kry dikwels ook verkoue as een kind in die klas dit het. Ons noem so 'n siekte oordraagbaar omdat dit van een mens na 'n ander oorgaan.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Common Cold' (cdc.gov/common-cold/about): colds spread from person to person through droplets and contaminated surfaces. Cambridge Dictionary, 'communicability': the ability of a disease to be passed from one person to another. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Die meeste oordraagbare siektes kom van iets baie klein, soos kieme of 'n virus.
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth, 'Germs: Bacteria, Viruses, Fungi, and Protozoa': germs are microscopic bacteria, viruses, fungi and protozoa that can cause disease. 'Die meeste' is correctly careful, because some communicable diseases come from larger parasites. On the point raised last round: no sentence in the lesson says that a virus is not a germ. 'kieme of 'n virus' names both without claiming they exclude each other. Together with the 'kieme' entry ('lewende dinge'), the pairing can still suggest to a learner that viruses sit outside kieme. That was put to a person last round. Under the standing curriculum ruling that kieme are described as living, it is not reopened here and is not a false statement. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Atleetvoet kom van 'n swam. Hierdie swam is ook 'n kiem, want dit is 'n baie klein lewende ding wat jou siek kan maak.
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth, 'Germs': fungi are germs, and athlete's foot is given as a fungal infection. Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Atleetvoet': caused by fungi (Trichophyton, Epidermophyton, Microsporum). NHS, 'Athlete's foot': a fungal infection. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Druppeltjies met kieme of 'n virus spat in die lug wanneer 'n siek mens hoes of nies. Hulle kan ook op hande en gedeelde dinge sit.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Common Cold': an infected person releases droplets when coughing or sneezing, and people are infected by breathing them in or by touching a contaminated surface and then the eyes, nose or mouth. CDC, 'About Mumps': spreads through items such as shared cups. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Party kieme leef op nat vloere waar mense kaalvoet loop.
items.bron: NHS, 'Athlete's foot', and Guy's and St Thomas' NHS, 'Athlete's foot': it spreads easily by walking barefoot where someone else had it, for example changing rooms at swimming pools and gyms. Nemours KidsHealth, 'Germs': fungi thrive in damp, warm places. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Pampoentjies kom van 'n virus wat deur druppeltjies en speeksel oorgaan as iemand hoes, nies of 'n beker deel.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Mumps': it spreads through direct contact with saliva or respiratory droplets, through sharing cups or water bottles, and through coughing, sneezing and talking. Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Pampoentjies': caused by the mumps virus. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: 'n Pynlike swelling verskyn onder en voor die oor langs die kakebeen aan een of albei kante.
items.bron: CDC, 'Clinical Features of Mumps': pain, tenderness and swelling of one or both parotid glands, and in 25% of patients only one side swells. Cleveland Clinic, 'Parotid Gland': it lies just below and in front of each ear, by the angle of the jaw. Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Pampoentjies': the parotid gland 'voor en onder die oor'. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Die kind het ook koors en hoofpyn en dit maak seer om te kou of sluk.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Mumps': fever, headache and a painful swollen jaw. Cleveland Clinic, 'Mumps': the swelling makes chewing and swallowing uncomfortable. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Tuberkulose (TB) kom van kieme wat meestal in die longe groei. Die kieme gaan deur die lug oor wanneer iemand met TB hoes.
items.bron: CDC, 'Tuberculosis: Causes and How It Spreads': TB germs spread through the air when someone with active TB coughs, speaks or sings, and they settle and grow in the lungs. WHO, 'Tuberculosis' fact sheet: caused by bacteria and most often affects the lungs. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Jy kry nie TB van 'n beker, bord of kos wat jy met iemand met TB deel nie.
items.bron: CDC, 'Tuberculosis: Causes and How It Spreads': TB is not spread by sharing food or drink. DC Health, 'How Does TB Spread?': not spread by sharing food or dishes. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Die belangrikste waarskuwing is 'n hoes wat twee weke of langer aanhou.
items.bron: National Department of Health, 'Do you have any of these symptoms? Knowing starts with getting screened for TB' (health.gov.za/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/tb-screening-info.pdf): a cough for two weeks or more is listed first. The WHO screening guidelines (NCBI NBK569328) use a prolonged cough of two weeks or more. Two weeks is the South African figure, and 'belangrikste' is defensible because the cough is the leading screening criterion. The block also hedges it. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Die mens kan ook koors hê en snags sweet. Hy word baie moeg en maerder sonder dat hy probeer.
items.bron: health.gov.za TB screening information: drenching night sweats, unexplained weight loss and fever. Mayo Clinic, 'Tuberculosis': fatigue, weight loss, fever and night sweats. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Nie elke hoes is TB nie, maar so 'n lang hoes moet wel kliniek toe gaan. Gaan vroeër as jy bekommerd is.
items.bron: health.gov.za TB screening information: visit your nearest clinic for free TB screening if you have these symptoms. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: 'n Verkoue kom van een van baie verskillende virusse. Dit gaan oor deur druppeltjies en deur hande wat die virus na jou neus of mond dra.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Common Cold': more than 200 viruses cause colds, rhinoviruses most often. They spread through droplets, and through touching contaminated surfaces and then the eyes, nose or mouth. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Jy nies en kry 'n loopneus of toe neus en 'n seer keel. Party mense hoes ook.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Common Cold' and Johns Hopkins Medicine, 'Common Cold': sneezing, a runny or stuffy nose, a sore throat and a cough. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Koue weer of nat hare alleen gee jou nie 'n verkoue nie, want die virus moet eers by jou inkom.
items.bron: Mayo Clinic Health System, 'Can wet hair make you sick?', and University Hospitals, 'Can You Catch a Cold By Going Outside with Wet Hair?': cold weather and wet hair do not cause colds, because colds come from viruses. 'Alleen' is correctly careful. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Waterpokkies kom ook van 'n virus. Dit gaan baie maklik oor deur die lug en wanneer iemand aan die blasies raak.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Chickenpox': caused by the varicella-zoster virus. It spreads by touching blister fluid or by breathing in particles, and it is very contagious. Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Waterpokkies': a contagious disease caused by VZV. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Die kind kry koors en voel moeg, en 'n jeukerige uitslag van kolle kom uit. Die kolle word blasies wat opdroog tot korsies.
items.bron: CDC, 'Chickenpox Symptoms and Complications': fever and tiredness, then a rash that turns into itchy, fluid-filled blisters, which then become scabs within about a week. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Moenie krap nie en bly by die huis totdat al die blasies korsies het.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Chickenpox': a person is contagious until all the lesions have scabbed over. Cleveland Clinic, 'Chickenpox': avoid scratching. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Atleetvoet word ook voetswam genoem, en die swam groei in warm en nat plekke soos tussen sweterige tone.
items.bron: Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Atleetvoet', and Nemours KidsHealth, 'Germs': fungi grow in damp, warm environments. NHS, 'Athlete's foot': between the toes. 'Voetswam' is the everyday Afrikaans name. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Dit gaan oor op nat vloere van storte en kleedkamers en deur handdoeke of skoene wat mense deel.
items.bron: NHS inform, 'Athlete's foot': communal showers and changing rooms. NHS, 'Athlete's foot': do not share towels, socks or shoes. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Die vel tussen die tone jeuk en lyk wit en klam en kan afskilfer of kraak.
items.bron: NHS inform, 'Athlete's foot': between the toes, cracked skin is usually white and soggy, and it can be dry and flaky. NHS: itchy. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Hoes en nies in jou elmboog of 'n snesie om die druppeltjies te vang. Was jou hande dikwels met seep en water.
items.bron: CDC, 'Healthy Habits: Coughing and Sneezing', and CDC, 'Hygiene and Respiratory Viruses Prevention': use a tissue or your elbow, and wash your hands with soap and water. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Moenie bekers, handdoeke of skoene met ander deel nie.
items.bron: CDC, 'About Mumps': shared cups spread mumps. NHS, 'Athlete's foot': do not share towels or shoes. This does not conflict with the TB block, because the advice covers the lesson's diseases in general. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Maak 'n venster oop vir vars lug en bly by die huis as jy siek is.
items.bron: PLOS Medicine, 'Natural Ventilation for the Prevention of Airborne Contagion' (PubMed 17326709), and PMC3716713, 'Natural ventilation reduces high TB transmission risk in traditional homes in rural KwaZulu-Natal': opening windows lowers the risk of airborne spread. CDC, 'Preventing Spread of Respiratory Viruses When You're Sick': stay home. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Droog jou voete goed af tussen die tone en dra plakkies in 'n gedeelde stort.
items.bron: NHS, 'Athlete's foot', and NHS Lothian leaflet: dry carefully between the toes, and wear flip-flops in changing rooms and showers. 'Plakkies' is the South African word for flip-flops. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Vertel 'n grootmens as jy siek voel en gaan saam kliniek toe. Die kliniek sê watter behandeling jy nodig het en gee vir party siektes medisyne.
items.bron: PLOS One, 'Utilization of the Primary Health Care Services in the Tshwane Region': South African primary health care clinics treat minor ailments and communicable diseases and provide essential drugs free of charge. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: TB kan gesond word as die mens sy medisyne klaar drink.
items.bron: WHO, 'Tuberculosis' fact sheet: TB is preventable and curable, it is treated with antibiotics, and the full course must be completed. health.gov.za TB screening information: take the treatment and be cured. In Afrikaans, 'medisyne drink' is normal usage for taking tablets. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: Vir 'n verkoue is dit gewoonlik rus en baie drink. Gaan wel kliniek toe as 'n verkoue nie beter word nie en dadelik as asemhaal moeilik word.
items.bron: CDC, 'Manage Common Cold': get rest and drink plenty of fluids. See a healthcare provider for difficulty breathing, or for symptoms that last more than 10 days or get worse. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: 'n Verpleegster of dokter kan jou vrae beantwoord. Die kliniek se plakkate en pamflette verduidelik ook baie siektes, en jy kan by jou skool vra. Nie alles wat mense sê of aanlyn staan, is waar nie. Vra by die kliniek as jy nie seker is nie.
items.bron: The Department of Health's own clinic material (health.gov.za, TB screening information) is exactly this kind of printed information. PLOS One (Tshwane PHC) lists school health among clinic services. The rest is uncontroversial guidance. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: oordraagbaar: "Gesê van 'n siekte wat van een mens na 'n ander kan oorgaan."
items.bron: Cambridge Dictionary, 'communicability': the ability of a disease to be passed from one person to another. Read alone, the entry is the standard dictionary sense. The broader public-health definition also includes transmission from animals, which the entry does not deny. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: kieme: "Baie klein lewende dinge wat 'n mens siek kan maak."
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth, 'Germs': germs are microscopic organisms that can cause disease. This is true of the bacteria and fungi the lesson calls kieme. How it treats viruses follows the standing curriculum ruling and is not reopened (see the 'Die meeste oordraagbare siektes' item). Read alone, the entry makes no claim about what every germ does. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: virus: "'n Baie klein ding wat net binne-in 'n liggaam skade kan doen."
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth, 'Germs': viruses are smaller than bacteria and need to be inside living cells to grow and reproduce. Read alone, 'net binne-in' limits where it does harm, not where it can exist. So the entry does not conflict with the lesson's droplets and hands that carry a virus. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: swam: "'n Lewende ding soos skimmel of 'n sampioen; party swamme is te klein om te sien en kan 'n mens siek maak."
items.bron: Nemours KidsHealth, 'Germs': fungi are living organisms, some cause infections such as athlete's foot, and they include moulds, mushrooms and microscopic forms. The comparison holds: mould and mushrooms really are fungi, so this is membership, not likeness. The clause 'te klein om te sien' keeps a learner from picturing mushrooms on a foot. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: pampoentjies: "'n Siekte wat deur 'n virus veroorsaak word, met 'n pynlike swelling onder en voor die oor aan een of albei kante."
items.bron: CDC, 'Clinical Features of Mumps'. Cleveland Clinic, 'Parotid Gland': below and in front of the ear. Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Pampoentjies'. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: tuberkulose: "'n Siekte wat deur kieme veroorsaak word, meestal in 'n mens se longe."
items.bron: WHO, 'Tuberculosis' fact sheet: caused by bacteria and most often affects the lungs. MedlinePlus: it can affect other parts of the body, so 'meestal' is correct. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: waterpokkies: "'n Siekte wat deur 'n virus veroorsaak word, met 'n jeukerige uitslag van blasies."
items.bron: CDC, 'Chickenpox Symptoms and Complications', and Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Waterpokkies': the varicella-zoster virus causes an itchy rash of blisters. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: atleetvoet: "'n Siekte wat deur 'n swam veroorsaak word, met jeukerige vel tussen die tone."
items.bron: NHS, 'Athlete's foot', and Afrikaans Wikipedia, 'Atleetvoet': a fungal infection with itching between the toes. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: kliniek: "'n Plek in die gemeenskap waar mense gesondheidsorg kry, of hulle siek is of gesond."
items.bron: PLOS One, 'Utilization of the Primary Health Care Services in the Tshwane Region': South African clinics provide immunisation, antenatal care, family planning and child growth monitoring as well as curative care, so they serve well people too. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

items.bewering: medisyne: "'n Middel wat help om siekte of pyn te behandel, of om te keer dat 'n mens siek word."
items.bron: WHO, 'Tuberculosis' fact sheet: medicines are used both to treat TB and as preventive treatment (TPT). That supports both halves of the entry. Checked afresh on 21 Sep 2026.

opsomming: Alles in die les is hierdie ronde opnuut nagegaan en klop met die bronne: die nuwe teken-inskrywing is op sy eie akkuraat en stem nou woordeliks ooreen met die sin in die studieteks, al die feite oor die vyf siektes, voorkoming, behandeling en die woordelys-inskrywings is bevestig, en geen sin sê dat 'n virus nie 'n kiem is nie, sodat die kieme-kwessie by die staande kurrikulumbesluit bly.
